steps: Run the component in a fresh temporary fixture workspace with only the approved fixture artifacts and injected adapters.
Inject clock, ID source, storage adapter, animation policy, and evidence resolver; prohibit ambient providers.
Attach browser console, network, navigation, download, and filesystem-write capture before loading the component.
Execute canonical, acknowledge, defer, validation-failure, undo, reload, and each evidence-link outcome journey.
Assert every evidence resolution is limited to fixture paths and that no request leaves the fixture origin.
Scan captured output and logs for credential-shaped strings and scan filesystem events for writes outside the fixture.
Repeat with a deliberately invalid resolver or forbidden external reference to force an isolation failure.
isolationProcedure.passCondition: All journeys complete with zero external network requests, zero credential-shaped output, zero writes outside the fixture, and evidence resolution limited to approved fixture artifacts; the deliberate failure is detected and reported.
isolationProcedure.failureEvidence: A deterministic record containing the failing journey, fixture and adapter versions, console and network captures, attempted external path or request, filesystem-write event if applicable, and the expected-versus-observed isolation result.

required: C-01: accessible-tree capture and two re-render checks proving all seven fixture fields and stable ID.
C-02: accessibility-tree link-name and source-order capture.
C-03: keyboard and pointer journeys plus focus-without-activation event/state capture.
C-07: colour-removed captures or structural/accessibility assertions for all seven statuses.
C-09: both approved D-07 viewports at 200% zoom and reduced motion, with overflow and content-preservation evidence.
C-14: captures of routine, significant, critical, and unknown severity treatments.
C-16: local fixture captures for resolved, missing, invalid, and unavailable links with network logs.
C-17: recorded manual screen-reader walkthrough naming screen reader, build, exercised paths, and omissions.
C-19: named current-build captures for all twenty states at both approved viewports plus owner fidelity acceptance.
C-20: console/network captures from the defined isolation procedure and its deliberate failing case.
deterministicBrowserEvidence.blockedBy: No component tests, browser harness, approved viewport/browser matrix, visual captures, accessibility run, screen-reader record, isolation procedure, or owner/release-review evidence exists.
